critical_code_review_comments: Note: renaming a field label (e.g. 'finish') in the bulk modal shows the label rendered twice — once under Filters and once under Spec Fields — because both sections list rows keyed on 'finish' and both are updated via shared field_label_overrides. This is intended per the request note; UI users may find seeing duplicate 'Surface Finish' entries confusing. Consider a subtle badge/tooltip clarifying the shared key.
